title: SPYDER Bone instrument transfer file (format 1)
description: Maps a scan from source_class (optionally one source_serial) to target_class, before any model preprocessing. Selected automatically: scan instrument class -> model instrument.trained_on_class; a file for one unit (source_serial) beats a class-wide one, and may map a unit to its own class (a lab's own standard-resolution unit). Versions are compared only within one id; between ids a bundled class-wide file comes before a user one.

operator.description: Ordered ops (a 'sequence'): gaussian_blur, affine_reflectance, pds_banded, resample, ... Large matrices go to .npy sidecars.

instrument_noise.description: an instrument's own noise, measured on its scans; overrides the noise tables' defaults for outputs read through this correction

visible_levels.description: whether the correction's visible levels (VNIR gain and offset, the 1250-1300 nm level) were fitted from paired scans. They are not display-only: the heat check reads them. not_fitted: heat reads the scan as measured, with a note. Absent: fitted (every correction made before this field fitted them).

second_opinion_gap.description: the S1_R2 second-opinion gap estimated for this correction (95th percentile of |S1_R2 - CONS3|); used instead of the profile's default only when estimated from at least 20 scans

validation.description: Paired-scan evidence: n pairs, residual RMS before/after, model prediction agreement before/after.

source_class.description: equal to target_class only in a file for one unit (source_serial)

source_serial.description: null = whole class; a serial makes the transfer unit-specific (most specific wins).

reader_offsets.description: per-reader additive offsets (wt%) added to the readings made through this correction: {model id: offset}; a consensus takes its components' offsets before the median. Each at most 5 wt% either way.
